title: Della Duck
blurb: Donald Duck's twin sister and, per modern canon, the mother of Huey, Dewey, and Louie — a minor comics reference for decades until DuckTales (2017) made her a lead character.
facts: Della is an anthropomorphic white duck with a yellow-orange bill, legs, and feet.
studio: Walt Disney Productions / Disney Television Animation
